 Inter Miami name XI for New England trip, final away game of regular season 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Inter Miami play their final away match of the regular season at New England Revolution on MLS Matchday 34, with line-ups confirmed. According to Inter Miami, kickoff at Gillette Stadium is seven p.m. ET.
 Inter Miami set up in a four-three-three. Dayne St. Clair starts in goal, behind Ian Fray, Casemiro, Micael and Gonzalo Luján. Rodrigo De Paul, Yannick Bright and Telasco Segovia are in midfield, with Leo Messi captain and Germán Berterame and Riquelme Fillipi in attack.
 OneFootball Videos
 The bench features Rocco Ríos Novo, Sergio Reguilón, Maximiliano Falcón, Facundo Mura, Matías Galarza, David Ayala, Santiago Morales, Luis Suárez and Daniel Pinter. Cristian González is head coach.
 New England Revolution also line up in a four-three-three. Matt Turner is in goal behind Ilay Feingold , Ethan Kohler, Joshua Wynder and Will Sands . Carles Gil, Matthew Polster and Brooklyn Raines start in midfield, with Peyton Miller, Dor Turgeman and Dániel Gazdag up front.
 Their substitutes are Donovan Parisian, Andrew Farrell, Tanner Beason, Mamadou Fofana, Diego Fagúndez , Jackson Yueill, Alhassan Yusuf, Griffin Yow and Luca Langoni. Marko Mitrović is head coach.
 Source: Inter Miami
